title: MHZ Ship Builder - palette pack
description: Schema for data/palette.json (SPEC section 11). A fixed 16-entry base LUT plus one full 16-entry alert palette per budget, and a role -> index map. Index position IS the LUT index the palette-quantizer shader maps to, so array order is load-bearing.

variants.description: Render-type palette variants (ADR 0049), each a full 16-entry LUT swapped in wholesale the way an alert is - but driven by the render type, not by a budget. An active budget alert always beats a variant. By convention every variant holds indices 3/7/11/14 (the warm ramp) and 15 (the warning red) byte-identical to base, so a selected part stays amber and a warning stays red whatever the variant; nothing enforces that but the selection stops reading as selected if it is broken.

ramps.description: Named multi-step shading ramps, each an ORDERED list of LUT indices from darkest band to brightest. A 3D part picks one entry per shading band, so every shaded face is already an exact palette colour and the quantizer cannot move it. Ramps must be listed dark -> light; nothing enforces that but the shading reads inverted if it is broken.
